display.purpose: Room titles and signature words; may crop at the viewport edge.

stencil.purpose: BAY 0n numerals and enamel sign headings.

serif.purpose: People and feeling only: founders' story, subtitles, the closing line.

label.purpose: Numbers, specs, captions, provenance labels; never below 11px.

shadows.name: object-drop
shadows.purpose: Physical objects on the dark ground: clippings, prints, run board.

shadows.name: cap-lift
shadows.purpose: Cut-out bottle caps under the bar glass (filter).

shadows.name: door-seam
shadows.purpose: The gold light under the gate's bay door; the only coloured glow besides the badge halo.

motion.name: ease-door

components.name: Tap Handle Button
components.description: The one CTA, "Pour One With Us": a tap handle pulls forward and a gold pour-line draws on hover.
components.css: .ds-tap { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--fire-red, #ea0322); color: var(--foam, #f2f2f2); font-family: 'Big Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.25rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s; } .ds-tap:hover { background: var(--fire-red-deep, #b5021a); } .ds-tap:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0bf45; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tap-handle { position: relative; width: 0.62em; height: 1.55em; transform-origin: 50% 100%; transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.18,1); } .ds-tap:hover .ds-tap-handle, .ds-tap:focus-visible .ds-tap-handle { transform: rotate(-26deg); } .ds-tap-handle i { position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); } .ds-tap-handle .k { top: 0; width: 0.42em; height: 0.42em; border-radius: 50%; background: #f2f2f2; } .ds-tap-handle .s { top: 0.3em; bottom: 0.18em; width: 0.34em; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(#f2f2f2,#cfcfcf); } .ds-tap-handle .f { bottom: 0; width: 0.56em; height: 0.22em; background: #d69e14; } .ds-tap-label { position: relative; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1; } .ds-tap-line { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -0.32em; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: #f0bf45; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1); } .ds-tap:hover .ds-tap-line, .ds-tap:focus-visible .ds-tap-line { transform: scaleX(1); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary choice on dark ground ("Not yet").
components.css: .ds-ghost { height: 56px; padding: 0 28px; border: 1px solid rgb(242 242 242 / 0.24); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #f2f2f2; font-family: 'Big Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.2rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, background-color 0.2s; } .ds-ghost:hover { border-color: #f2f2f2; background: rgb(242 242 242 / 0.05); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0bf45; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Bay Label
components.description: Stencil bay numeral that opens every room; the building's wayfinding.
components.html: BAY 03The bar top
components.css: .ds-bay { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; margin: 0; color: #d69e14; } .ds-bay .n { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Stencil', 'Big Shoulders', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-bay .r { width: 32px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; opacity: 0.6; transform: translateY(-0.3em); } .ds-bay .t { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Confirm Chip

components.name: Enamel Placard
components.description: Red porcelain-enamel house-rules sign with a white keyline and screws.
components.html:
Good to know

  • Family-friendly
  • Walk-ins welcome
  • No dogs (for now)
  • Gift cards
components.css: .ds-placard { position: relative; max-width: 30rem; padding: 28px 32px; border-radius: 10px; background: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 30% 0%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14), transparent 55%), #b5021a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 6px #b5021a, inset 0 0 0 8px rgb(242 242 242 / 0.92), 0 30px 60px -30px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9); color: #f2f2f2; } .ds-placard h3 { margin: 0 0 16px; text-align: center; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Stencil', 'Big Shoulders', sans-serif; font-size: 2rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; } .ds-placard ul { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; column-gap: 32px; } .ds-placard li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(242 242 242 / 0.28); font-family: 'Big Shoulders', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-placard li::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; background: #f2f2f2; transform: rotate(45deg); }

components.name: Photo Slot
components.description: Honest placeholder print for a real photo: dark frame, brass corner clips, mono caption.
components.css: .ds-slot { position: relative; margin: 0; width: 240px; padding: 12px; background: #0d0e10; box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -30px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9); } .ds-slot .in { display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 8px; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; border: 1px solid rgb(242 242 242 / 0.12); background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(242 242 242 / 0.025) 0 1px, transparent 1px 14px), #141518; text-align: center; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-slot figcaption { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f2f2f2; } .ds-slot p { margin: 0; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #c9c3b9; } .ds-slot .c { position: absolute; width: 20px; height: 20px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#f3d48a,#b98a2c 45%,#6f4f15); clip-path: polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% 28%,28% 28%,28% 100%,0 100%); } .ds-slot .tl { left: -4px; top: -4px; } .ds-slot .tr { right: -4px; top: -4px; transform: rotate(90deg); } .ds-slot .br { right: -4px; bottom: -4px; transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-slot .bl { left: -4px; bottom: -4px; transform: rotate(-90deg); }

components.name: Mono Spec Row
components.description: Brew-sheet data line for a tap: number, name, ABV, IBU in tabular mono.
components.css: .ds-spec { margin: 0; color: #d69e14; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The page is one building, walked room by room. You arrive at a closed bay door, are let in, and every section after that is a bay of the firehouse: the brewhouse, the bar top, the kitchen, Eli's Lounge, the run board, the street out front. Brix Black is the night the building stands in. Pour Gold is the only light: beer, Edison bulbs, active states, the glow leaking under the door. Fire Red is enamel and the single call to act. Everything else is a material the building is actually made of (brick, mortar, walnut, brushed stainless, bottle caps under glass) rendered as raster, never imitated with gradients.

Density is editorial: one idea per viewport, huge condensed civic type cropped by the viewport, long dark fields between rooms, and small mono labels carrying the data the way a brew sheet or dispatch log would. Motion is heavy and weighted, like a rolling door: things settle; they don't bounce.

Rejected outright: the craft-brewery default (centred beer photo over cream, three amenity cards, stock taproom gallery) and firehouse theme-park dressing (clip-art flames, Dalmatians, hose borders, grunge overload).
keyCharacteristics: Dark ground at page scale; gold is light, red is enamel and the CTA.
Real materials as fields and objects, each a labelled illustrative raster.
Civic signage type, huge and edge-cropped; a warm italic serif for human moments; mono for data.
Square corners and 1px hairlines; round only for round things (caps, dots); 10px only for enamel signs.
Every unknown fact is a visible `{{CONFIRM}}` chip, never a guess.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only light source. Glows, highlights, and active states are gold; never blue, white neon, or a second accent.

rules.name: The Enamel Red Rule
rules.body: Red is for fire-service enamel, real red objects in the building (a bottle cap, a shuffleboard weight), and the single CTA. If it isn't a sign, an object, a gate "Yes", or "Pour One With Us", it isn't red.

rules.name: The Real Material Rule
rules.body: Brick, wood, steel, paper and caps are raster textures with an "Illustrative render" caption. CSS gradients may shade a material; they never stand in for one.

rules.name: The Brew Sheet Rule
rules.body: Numbers (ABV, IBU, times, dates, prices) are set in mono with tabular figures, like a brew log.

rules.name: The Human Italic Rule
rules.body: The serif italic is reserved for people and feeling. It never carries data or UI labels.

rules.name: The Five-Second Rule
rules.body: On a phone, hours, directions and the menu are reachable in one tap from anywhere via the fixed action bar.

rules.name: The Neutral Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are black. Coloured glow is light, and light is gold: the seam under the bay door and the halo behind the gate badge, nowhere else.

dos: Do open every room with a stencil Bay Label and give it a real material from the building.
Do caption every generated visual "Illustrative render" (food: "Illustrative, not the actual dish") in mono at 11px or larger.
Do set every number in mono with tabular figures.
Do mark any unverified fact with a visible `{{CONFIRM}}` chip.
Do let signature display words crop at the viewport edge, but never so far that the meaning changes.
Do honour reduced motion with a fully static, complete page (the hero becomes a still on the door-open frame).
donts: Don't use gradient text, neon, or any glow that isn't gold light.
Don't imitate a material with CSS (striped "wood", gradient "steel"); use the raster or leave it out.
Don't use red for UI beyond the gate "Yes" and the CTA; elsewhere it belongs to enamel signs and real red objects.
Don't round corners on UI; round only round objects, and 10px only on enamel.
Don't generate people, the real logo, Larry Meag's art, signage or text in imagery.
Don't add fire-service clip art: flames, Dalmatians, hose borders, helmet icons.
